description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: stack of chopped firewood, wooden dog sled, rack of fur pelts drying, ice fishing hole with a wooden fishing rod and a small pile of frozen fish, pair of wooden snowshoes and skis leaning on a rack, wooden notice board with pinned blank paper notes, small mine cart full of blue ice blocks, short stone waystone pillar encased in thick ice with a faint glowing blue rune, small campfire ringed with stones, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
